title: AdaC-GRPO: Towards Mastering Long-Horizon Visual Sudoku Puzzles via Adaptive Curriculum Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.13184v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR) enhances reasoning in large language models, its efficacy in long-horizon multimodal tasks remains underexplored. Visual Sudoku puzzles pose a representative challenge, requiring multi-step deductive reasoning over both local constraints and global dependency chains. To this end, we introduce FG-Sudoku, a fine-grained benchmark categorized by grid size and required deductive steps. Evaluations reveal that frontier MLLMs fail on complex long-range dependencies (e.g., 9*9 puzzles). During post-training, this near-zero success rate causes severe reward sparsity, halting standard RLVR. We propose Adaptive Curriculum Group Relative Policy Optimization (AdaC-GRPO) to overcome this. Unlike rigid or prior-based schedules, AdaC-GRPO dynamically constructs training batches by tracking the model's "Zone of Proximal Development" via online rollout accuracy. translated_abstract: 虽然可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）能够增强大语言模型的推理能力，但其在长程多模态任务中的有效性仍未得到充分探索。视觉数独谜题构成了一项代表性的挑战，需要对局部约束和全局依赖链进行多步演绎推理。为此，我们提出了FG-Sudoku，这是一个按网格大小和所需演绎步骤分类的细粒度基准。评估结果显示，前沿的多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在处理复杂的远程依赖时会失败（例如9*9数独）。在后训练过程中，这种接近于零的成功率导致严重的奖励稀疏问题，使标准RLVR方法停滞不前。为克服这一问题，我们提出了自适应课程组相对策略优化。与僵化的或基于先验的课程安排不同，AdaC-GRPO通过在线rollout准确率追踪模型的“最近发展区”，从而动态构建训练批次。实验表明，AdaC-
tldr: 提出AdaC-GRPO方法，通过在线rollout准确率追踪模型的“最近发展区”来动态构建训练批次，从而克服长程视觉数独任务中因奖励稀疏导致标准RLVR失效的问题。
en_tdlr: AdaC-GRPO dynamically constructs training batches by tracking the model's "Zone of Proximal Development" through online rollout accuracy, overcoming reward sparsity in long-horizon visual Sudoku tasks where standard RLVR stalls due to near-zero success rates.
